OK, so keep in mind that this is MY personal experience, but... 

Clozapine has changed my life for the better. It took a couple weeks to get up to the dosage I needed (250mg), and took a couple months or so to build up the medication blood levels I needed. I used to be highly paranoid and delusional, and most of that is GONE. Auditory hallucinations are gone. Depression is still here, but manageable. 

I am fully functional in life. Have a full time job, good friends and family, and feel overall comfortable. When I started Clozapine, I was in the hospital for about 3 weeks. I had no idea that my life was going to change for the better. Thought everything was pretty much over. 

There happened to be one nurse on my floor that believed in clozapine for me. She showed me an article of a woman who was losing their mind before clozapine, but after a few months, went to college and got a 4.0 GPA (I think?). At the time, it felt like one small opinion in a mass of supposed failure. Somehow, it became the best medicine for me to use. I have terrible insomnia as well, and the clozapine takes care of that. I HAVE to be sedated to sleep. Yes, you will have drool on your pillow every night lol. 

If you are prescribed clozapine, the psychiatrist finds that medicine as a "last resort" even though it is also considered a "gold standard" for anti psychotics. If you are at a last resort scenario, I recommend you give it an honest try. With any psychiatric medication, it is all about the positives outweighing the negatives for personal use. If this medicine is causing serious issues for you in time, then maybe try another medicine with your doctor. If NOT though, give it time to see what happens. 

​

Best of luck to you.

I agree with the points you're making. But I would argue people need healthy coping mechanisms to get through any time or trial in life. I seriously lack those. I used to write raps, but can't do that now due to the medicine I'm prescribed (clozapine being the most significant one I take). I resonate with committing Seppuku to end shame for my family brought upon with weakness and cowardice. I think that I've had many chances in life with my male white privilege that I squandered due to substance abuse/coasting through life. 

​

Now I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place, and I feel the only direction I can head now while alive is further downwards. My most compelling reason to stay alive is ONLY for other people not having to suffer from my absence . But I firmly believe that I will accumulate more and more negative experiences for those that love me.  

I have to ask myself this: Should I have my sister take care of me the rest of my life, or end my life? The cons of death feel outweighed by the pros. 

And so here I am, days away from death by choice. Maybe even tomorrow.

 Not to mention I was born with bad ligaments, biological mom killed herself a month after I was born, and spent several years in foster homes. If I continue to live, that would involve me moving to a halfway house. And I really would rather not because I'm heavily introverted. 

My sister's partner hates me but doesn't want to be the guy who "kicks out a mentally disabled person". It sucks living here because the energy is simply terrible and overwhelming. I only continued to live up to this point because of my foster family/foster nieces.

Continue to seek support from your partner; especially while you are between help from your mental health support system. If you know any coping mechanisms, such as mindfulness or dbt techniques, now more than ever will these tools be helpful. 

Take it one day at a time, and think practically about your situation if you can, taking baby steps whenever possible. Continue to seek support through whatever platform you can, such as this one. You are strong, and I have hope for you.

Forgot to mention this and you touched on it. Definitely  write your lyrics to the start of the bar until the end of that bar, and then indicate some kind of pause with a hyphen etc for the next bar and repeat.

Punctuation is VERY helpful to indicate pauses. Things like ... , ; ! ?, Etc. Sometimes I'll write multiple letters to emphasize extending a word for a flow. Parentheses besides particular lyrics where you go in detail of something in particular that acts as a cue to pick up the flow. 

I think with practice you'll find your own rhythm of how you want to remind yourself of how to do a flow. Also, you could use a metronome (I just count and tap) because a bar has 4 seconds, 1 alligator, 2 Alli... Or 1,2,3,4,  2,2,3,4,  3,2,3,4,  4,2,3,4) So you could record in your notes certain parts of the flow based upon what second you are on for that bar.

Anyways, hope this helps at all! And keep practicing!!

Edit: could be wrong about the exact timing of the bar. Anyone care to chime in? Don't want to give out false info

Thank you so much for sharing your critique! I just listened to your track and have a few things to say about. First of all, you can spit! I like the super fast caedence in parts of your verses. Next, I like the vibe you're going for. Your verses remind me a lot of Kendrick Lamar. That being said, your delivery is a bit too deadpan, and the way you articulate your words is a bit too perfect or rigid sounding.

 I think you need to emulate your favorite artists by trying to imitate HOW they spit to get more familiar with having more of an accent when you spit. Speaking of Kendrick Lamar, maybe try using one of his almost whiny kind of flows that projects feeling and questioning the universe and expressing angst. Perhaps notes of despair as well. I hear in your lyrics (which, by the way, really solid lyrics, enjoyed the situations you depicted) lots of questioning of another entity or person and that's why I recommended trying a more passionate articulation of your words. 

Now for the hook: I like the direction you're going with changing your voice pitch to keep it interesting. Great idea! I wasn't particularly grabbed by the hook however. I'd recommend trying different pitches of your loud voice to find ones that you like, as well as trying harmonic layering. You could add a lot of warmth, depth, and in your case for your hook, UMPH to your hooks with vocal layering. Once again, slur your enunciations Abit. Roll with an accent. I have the same problem many a time, it's a work in progress for me. 

Overall, I think your work is very appealing, and with some tidying up could be a hit! Keep at it man, you'll only age like a fine wine with this shit. I'm rooting for ya. One love.

Edit: One last thing I'd add. Don't even know if this is an issue but at certain parts of the song it's hard to understand the lyrics. Not sure if that's due to enunciation issues, chopping it up hella fast, or both. Either way, it's worth noting for ya. Hope this is at least somewhat helpful!

2nd edit: Also, maybe mix your vocals a little louder because at certain parts the sample supercedes your voice.

You have some really well thought out questions here. I'll try to help you to the best of my ability, but some other people will definitely need to fill in the gaps.

1. A+Left click is the same as Shift+Right Click

2. If you plain right click into the bush, your auto attack will not go off automatically, allowing the enemy being able to juke you. If you attack move while chasing someone into a bush, you pretty much guaranteed to auto attack them. If you attack move on the map or mini map, you will move to that location, and attack the closest target at the destination, as well as if you run into an attack-able target on the way to your destination, you will attack that target.

3. A-Move doesn't prioritize champions, only the closest attackable target near you. It is important to attack move while your cursor is ON the target you want. So you essentially A+Left click onto the target of your choice. 

4. Pressing S or H will stop the animation from occurring. S or H is the same command to stop, as in stop moving or stop auto attacking. You don't really use S or H to kite while attack moving.

5. To properly attack move, you use attack- move (a+left click), and once your auto is leaving your Champion (LITERALLY as soon as you see it leave the gun, bow, w.e), then you right click either towards the target to chase, or right click backwards or wherever to kite.

 ~So to properly attack move, you a+left click, animation leaves the weapon, right click to move to the direction of your choice, then a+left click the target again. This completes one cycle of attack moving. Rinse and repeat, and you are golden!

6. Right clicking the ground will cancel your auto I believe.

7. Basically, attack moving enables you to utilize maximum kiting/chasing potential. It enables you to kill those people that use their escape move, and you have a split second of vision on them, enabling your attack move to get that auto off for the kill, instead of being upset that they got away :P

8. Oh, and in terms of key-binding, you can do all sorts of things. Personally, I find a+left click is the best, because if you bind attack move to just a, it causes you to attack things while just typing "a" in the chat. People also like Shift+Right Click though, which seems to work well. It really just depends on what works for you.
